title: Human sign-in handoff
summary: After the operator completes a sign-in on a test machine, save it with golden-capture, which proves real requests before recapturing. Diagnose native probe failures first: quota waits for provider capacity, transport waits for recovery, and sign-in advice requires actual authentication evidence. Unknown nonzero failures preserve the golden and direct local diagnosis. Harness login files stay live through every reset on macOS, Linux and WSL, so a completed sign-in is never rolled back by a reset. A managed browser blocked by browser_human_gate_active names the identity, project, PID and elapsed window time. Hand off to steering or the person at that machine to finish or close the sign-in window, or quit the named PID, then retry; do not wait unattended. Sign-in windows close at the 30-minute limit; managed Chromium is force-stopped after its 10-second shutdown margin if needed. Gate markers older than that combined bound are removed even when the recorded PID is alive. yoke browser authorize first quits a Chromium an earlier run left holding the profile and drops the tabs an earlier window left (keeping the sign-in), so the window shows only this run's starting URLs; one still running after 10 seconds refuses authorization_profile_in_use naming its PID: quit it, then rerun.
